title: Pomodoro Timer
description: Build a Pomodoro timer with work/break sessions, session counting, and history logging.

steps.title: Session configuration
steps.description: Create a config object with `workDuration` (25 min), `breakDuration` (5 min), and `longBreakDuration` (15 min) in seconds.

verification.failureMessage: Include workDuration, breakDuration, longBreakDuration, and longBreakInterval.

steps.title: startSession function
steps.description: Write `startSession(type)` that starts a timer for the given session type (`'work'`, `'break'`, or `'longBreak'`). Log `'Starting [type] session for [duration] seconds'`.
hints: Look up the duration from config based on type
Use setInterval to count down each second
Store the remaining time and interval ID

hints: Determine next type: work -> break, break -> work
